name: 三影敲门 · 学徒篇 VOL.4（中级）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP5M《三影敲门·学徒篇》中级档（学徒版）语法命门 12 题。本卷的看图命门（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、单词接龙、角色互批区依赖纸面主图与机关，未进题库。

m5.q: There ___ nine coins on the step and one more in Ming's hand.
m5.why: there be 看最近的主语，nine coins 是复数，用 are。

m5.q: Jun ___ his old ball everywhere. He never leaves it at home.
m5.why: 主语 Jun 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s。

m5.q: Ming's father ___ the coins in a paper bag two years ago, and Ming still keeps them today.
m5.why: two years ago 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时；put 的过去式与原形同形。

m5.q: The window is ___ high that Jie has to raise his arm to knock on it.
m5.why: so + 形容词 + that 从句，表示“如此……以至于……”。

m5.q: ___ of the three boys is standing outside. Nobody has gone in.
m5.why: Each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is，表示“三人中的每一个”。

m5.q: If it ___ tomorrow night, the three boys will still wait at the door.
m5.why: if 引导的条件句用一般现在时表示将来，主句用 will（主将从现）。

m5.q: Jie has five prizes on his net, but Jun has ___ prizes than Jie does — he has none at all.
m5.why: prizes 是可数名词复数，“更少的奖品”用 fewer。

m5.q: Jun's ball is very old. It ___ to him by his uncle three years ago.
m5.why: 球是“被给”的，主语是物；three years ago 是过去时间，用一般过去时的被动 was given。

m5.q: — I'm afraid I can't wait here any longer.　— ___ Let's come back tomorrow.
m5.why: 对方表达为难，回应“没关系”，再提出新方案，语气自然。

m5.q: Jun's mother made him ___ two pieces of bread before he left home.
m5.why: make sb do sth，中间的不定式不带 to。

m5.q: Neither Jie nor his two friends ___ the last level of the game.
m5.why: neither...nor 用就近原则，靠近谓语的是 his two friends（复数），用 have。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: Each of them is waiting outside the door.
Ming have kept the coins for two years.
There is a lamp and three shadows on the wall.
The tenth place on the string is still empty.
m5.why: 主语 Ming 是第三人称单数，现在完成时要用 has kept。
